climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West appellation of about 3,200 acres, spread over three départements and built on red Tannat, with Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Fer. White Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh comes from the same area.
